newsitem.title: USA: Gothic offers to buy Pittencrieff.
newsitem.headline: Gothic offers to buy Pittencrieff.

text.p: Gothic Energy Corp said Wednesday that it has signed a letter of intent to make an offer to purchase all the outstanding stock of Pittencrieff Resources Plc for $0.979 per share.
The aggregate purchase price for the shares, assuming all shares are tendered, is 34.5 million pounds sterling (about $56,342,000, based on current exchange rates), or 60 pence per share.
Pittencrieff is an oil and gas exploration and production company with interests in about 1,600 producing oil and gas wells in the United States and Canada.
Gothic Energy is an oil and gas acquisition, exploitation, development and production company.
